senses.gloss: a delay between an action and its result

definition_translations.zh_TW: 行動與結果之間的延遲
definition_translations.ja_JP: 行動と結果の間の遅れ
definition_translations.vi_VN: độ trễ giữa hành động và kết quả

senses.gloss: to move, develop, or progress more slowly than others
senses.example: Sales lagged behind expectations during the first quarter.

example_translations.zh_TW: 第一季的銷售落後於預期。
example_translations.ja_JP: 第1四半期の売上は予想を下回った。

definition_translations.ja_JP: 他より遅く動く、発展する、または進む
